2.163.15
GaugePanel.Width
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The GaugePanel.Width element specifies the width of a GaugePanel. The GaugePanel.Width
element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be an RdlSize. If the
GaugePanel.Width element is not present, its value is interpreted as the width of the gauge panel's
container (such as a Rectangle or Body) minus the value of the peer GaugePanel.Left element, if
specified.
The following is the parent element of the GaugePanel.Width element.
Parent elements
GaugePanel
The following is the XML Schema definition of the GaugePanel.Width element.
 <xsd:element name="Width" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0">
